name: 97720 · Burns, OR
findings: ZIP 97720 (Burns) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97720 (Burns) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
